title: Research Publications
bodyHtml:
We publish mainly in top HCI venues, including ACM CHI, UIST, IMWUT, DIS, TEI and other science venues (npj, Science Advances, Advanced Healthcare Materials)

2025:

  1. Huang, Luyao, Tingyu Cheng, Xianzhe Zhang, Haichao Zhang, Tejonidhi Deshpande, Yuanqiao Li, Zhi Xu et al. "Bioinspired Camouflage Fibers with Computer Vision-Guided Chromatic Adaptation." ACS nano 19, no. 21 (2025): 19697-19705.

  2. Huang, Han, Tingyu Cheng, Jinzhi Ye, Yuhui Zhao, Yiyang Wang, Haiqing Xu, Abigale Stangl, and HyunJoo Oh. "Eliciting Design Guidelines of Paper-Based Tactile Interfaces for Eyes-Free Scenarios." In Proceedings of the Nineteenth International Conference on Tangible, Embedded, and Embodied Interaction, pp. 1-15. 2025.

  3. Do, Youngwook, Tingyu Cheng, Yuxi Wu, HyunJoo Oh, Daniel J. Wilson, Gregory D. Abowd, and Sauvik Das. "On-demand RFID: Improving Privacy, Security, and User Trust in RFID Activation through Physically-Intuitive Design." USEC 2025.

2024:

  1. Honnet, Cedric, Tianhong Catherine Yu, Irmandy Wicaksono, Tingyu Cheng, Andreea Danielescu, Cheng Zhang, Stefanie Mueller, Joe Paradiso, and Yiyue Luo. "Democratizing Intelligent Soft Wearables." In Adjunct Proceedings of the 37th Annual ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology, pp. 1-3. 2024.

  2. Cheng, Tingyu, Zhihan Zhang, Han Huang, Yingting Gao, Wei Sun, Gregory D. Abowd, HyunJoo Oh, and Josiah Hester. "Recy-ctronics: Designing Fully Recyclable Electronics With Varied Form Factors." arXiv preprint arXiv:2406.09611 (2024).

2023:

  1. Jiachen Li, Bingrui Zong, Tingyu Cheng, Yunzhi Li, Elizabeth D Mynatt, Ashutosh Dhekne. “Privacy vs. Awareness: Relieving the Tension between Older Adults and Adult Children When Sharing In-home Activity Data” CSCW 2023

  2. Zeyu Yan, Tingyu Cheng, Jasmine Lu, Pedro Lopes, Huaishu Peng. “Future Paradigms for Sustainable Making” Adjunct Proc. ACM UIST 2023

  3. Hyunjoo Oh, Sherry Hsi, Noah Posner, Colin Dixon, Tymirra Smith, Tingyu Cheng. “Making Computing Visible & Tangible: A Paper-Based Computing Toolkit for Codesigning Inclusive Computing Education Activities” International Journal of Child-Computer Interaction (IJCCI)

  4. Akash Talyan, Tingyu Cheng, Wei Wang, Clement Zheng, and HyunJoo Oh. “Kirisense: Making Rigid Materials Bendable and Functional.” The 10th International Association of Societies of Design Research Congress. IASDR Congress 2023

  5. Tingyu Cheng, Gregory D. Abowd, Hyunjoo Oh, Josiah Hester. “Transient Internet of Things: Redesigning the Lifetime of Electronics for a More Sustainable Networked Environment” Hotcarbon 2023

  6. Tingyu Cheng, Taylor Tabb, Jung Wook Park, Eric M Gallo, Aditi Maheshwari, Gregory D. Abowd, Hyunjoo Oh, Andreea Danielescu et al. “Functional Destruction: Utilizing sustainable materials' physical transiency for electronics applications” CHI 2023

  7. Tingyu Cheng, Zhihan Zhang, Bingrui Zong, Yuhui Zhao, Zekun Chang, Ye Jun Kim, Clement Zheng, Gregory D. Abowd, Hyunjoo Oh et al. “SwellSense: Creating 2.5D interactions with micro-capsule paper.” CHI 2023

  8. Jung Wook Park, Sienna Xin Sun, Tingyu Cheng, Dong Whi Yoo, Jiawei Zhou, Youngwook Do, Gregory D Abowd, Rosa I Arriaga et al. “Exergy: A Toolkit to Simplify Creative Applications of Wind Energy Harvesting.” IMWUT 2023
